neighbours.label: the token ' below' (and similar second terms) completing a vertical position contrast such as 'above and below'
fire: The divers counted fish both above and below the old reef wall.
Readings were taken above and below the dam every morning.
Students scoring above or below the cutoff were sent different letters.
Fossils appear in the rock layers above and below the ash bed.
The pilot could see clouds above and below the aircraft.
Prices well above or below the average were flagged by the system.
Lights were fitted above and below each shelf in the cabinet.
The thermometer showed whether the oven ran above or below the set point.
quiet: The divers counted fish along the edge of the old reef wall.
Readings were taken upstream of the dam every morning.
Students scoring near the cutoff were sent different letters.
Fossils appear in the rock layers around the ash bed.
The pilot could see clouds ahead of the aircraft.
Prices far from the average were flagged by the system.
Lights were fitted along the front of each shelf in the cabinet.
The thermometer showed whether the oven had reached the set point.

notes: Card: ' below' is 12 of the top 32 peaks, mostly in 'above and below' / 'above or below'; also ' of' in 'left or right of' and ' than'.
